# Siemens Washing Machine Repair Mumbai

> Independent Siemens washing machine repair service in Mumbai. Same-day service, genuine spare parts, experienced technicians, and 1+ year warranty on installed parts.

We are an independent repair service (not an official Siemens service centre) specialising in Siemens washing machines across Mumbai and its suburbs. We also service all other major washing machine brands.
